_flow_.description: Execution flow for transforming candidate Field state into provenance-qualified academic Field state through the declared Candidate-to-Academic provenance mechanism.

process.instruction: Load the complete candidate Field state from bsd2field_candidate.json without modifying candidate identities or observation traces.
Execute candidate aggregation, external evidence retrieval, and Field qualification according to _bsd2field_cand2acad_prov_.
Project only provenance-supported Field identities into academic_based_fields_set while preserving all qualification outcomes in provenance_result.
Validate the generated state according to the identity conservation, status exclusivity, and projection equivalence constraints declared by _bsd2field_cand2acad_prov_.
Materialize the validated provenance-qualified Field state into bsd2field_generated.json without modifying bsd2field_candidate.json.
